input.summary: Cap the non-solicit at 12 months from the end of the employee's involvement and add an unsolicited-approach carve-out.
input.comment: [Playbook] We capped the non-solicit at twelve months measured from the end of the individual's involvement (replacing the Term-plus-undisclosed tail) and added the customary unsolicited-approach carve-out alongside the existing general-advertising carve-out. The clause otherwise remains mutual, limited to involved personnel and solicitation-only.

ops.oldText: During the Term and for a period of [***] thereafter, neither Party
ops.newText: For twelve (12) months after an employee's involvement in the development activities hereunder ends, neither Party

ops.oldText: nothing herein shall restrict or preclude the Parties' right to make generalized searches for employees by way of a general solicitation for employment placed in a trade journal, newspaper or website.
ops.newText: nothing herein shall restrict or preclude the Parties' right to make generalized searches for employees by way of a general solicitation for employment placed in a trade journal, newspaper or website, or to respond to any employee who approaches a Party on an unsolicited basis.
